description: Filter-bank CSP with LDA for cross-subject motor imagery decoding. We use three physiologically motivated bands (8–12, 12–18, 18–26 Hz) and compute per-band Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) with small covariance shrinkage, extracting 3 pairs (6 comps) per band and using log-normalized component variances as features. Additionally, we compute lateralization features: per-band log-power differences for four symmetric channel pairs (C3–C4, CP3–CP4, FC3–FC4, C1–C2) to capture contralateral mu/beta desynchronization robustly across subjects. Signals are zero-phase Butterworth band-pass filtered. Features from all bands are concatenated, z-scored on the training set, and classified with shrinkage LDA (solver='lsqr', shrinkage='auto'). Deterministic seed and fixed hyperparameters are used; no test labels or calibration are used and no within-test adaptation is performed. Primary metric is balanced accuracy; no cross-validation is run to avoid overfitting and to maintain speed.
